description: Receive recognition-pack status events, open the product homepage and the bug report page (decision 0147: the report travels in the address's fragment and the user sends it from the website), set the window theme chosen in Settings, save a masked copy to the one path picked in the save dialog (the dialog adds only that file to the fs scope), and, for a masked folder (decision 0171), pick a folder with the folder dialog (which adds only that folder to the fs scope) and create the output folder and its subfolders inside it; a large CSV or text file is written into it a piece at a time (decision 0174: open, write, close). Model downloads accept no URLs; the local tokenizer receives transient text and never persists or transmits it. Quick actions (decision 0090): register one global shortcut, read the clipboard only on that shortcut or a panel button, write the result back, and send the outcome to the floating panel window. Background mode (decision 0092): the window hides itself on close and the login item can be turned on or off.
